title: [review] messaging.py:158: Callback mutation causes inbox
description: In render_post, _sent receives a deepcopy of body at line 150, but _sent_detail_registrar callback at line 158-159 receives the original shallow copy. If the registrar modifies body before returning, deliver(body) at line 160 stores the modified version in inbox while _sent retains the pre-modification deepcopy. Same message ID will have different content in inbox vs sent.
